tasks.subject: Confirm the error modal text with the device unlocked
tasks.description: SKIPPED by the human 2026-08-21, and no longer reproducible as originally written. foundry.digitallabor.dev has since FIXED its metadata server-side: the `av` mso_mdoc config now correctly ships credential_signing_alg_values_supported=[-7] (COSE integers), so firing the foundry deep link can no longer produce the malformed-metadata modal that named 'av'. That path is instead covered offline by IssuerMetadataDiagnosticsTest against the FOUNDRY_CAPTURE fixture (the trimmed capture of the broken document, inlined in the test rather than app/src/test/resources). Reproducing it on-device again would need an https endpoint serving deliberately malformed issuer metadata — plain-http/localhost will not do, because describeOfferFailure guards the diagnostic re-fetch on the issuer id starting with "https://". Also unresolved and worth a look on its own: a repeat deep-link fire against the same unresolvable offer left the UI stuck on "Resolving credential offer…" for 45s+ with no IssuanceClient log line and no visible 20s Ktor requestTimeoutMillis abort, where the first fire had failed in under a second.
